name: Term / Definition
purpose: Defines a term without pretending the definition proves a world-claim.

name: Evidence
purpose: Records what supports or challenges a claim, how it bears, and its limitations.

name: MTL / Equation
purpose: Stores a formal object, its symbols, assumptions, derivation status, and plain-language translation.

name: Physics Event
purpose: Records an empirical physical event or phenomenon with measurable conditions.

name: Isomorphism
purpose: Records a proposed structure-preserving mapping and the tests it must pass.

name: Analogy / Metaphor
purpose: Records a non-propagating comparison that aids understanding but does not prove identity.

name: Trinity Pattern
purpose: Records a proposed triadic structure with an explicit theological-identification boundary.

name: Axiom
purpose: Records an irreducible starting commitment and its scope.

name: Law Mapping
purpose: Connects a physical law to a spiritual principle without hiding bridge assumptions.

name: Operator
purpose: Records a transformation rule, input and output types, invariants, and failure conditions.

name: Falsification / Kill Condition
purpose: States what would weaken, bound, or destroy a target claim.

name: Audit
purpose: Records a reproducible inspection, its scope, tools, results, and unresolved gaps.

name: Source Atom
purpose: Preserves source language, provenance, location, and hash before interpretation.

name: Media
purpose: Connects audio, images, video, and transcripts to the objects they represent.

name: Reviewer State
purpose: Records a reviewer judgment without mutating the underlying object or admitting it to canon.
